summary: Practise employee goal-setting, feedback, reviews and improvement plans. Explore the five-day course and plan your next step with TrainingCred.
lede: Managing performance training gives line managers a practical way to set expectations, review work and document follow-up. For HR practitioners and team supervisors as well, practice includes SMART goals, KPI evidence logs and SBI feedback records. You also prepare review conversations, use GROW coaching questions and draft performance improvement plans for missed goals.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who set work expectations, review employee contribution or support managers with fair performance records and follow-up.
prerequisites: No specialist HR analytics or coding background is required. Familiarity with routine people-management responsibilities will help you apply the exercises to your work.
